## Common WHERE Filters

### 分区过滤 (Partition Filter)
```sql
-- 单日快照 (最常见)
grass_date = DATE('${grass_date}')

-- L7D 范围
grass_date BETWEEN date_sub('${grass_date}', 6) AND date'${grass_date}'

-- 全量滚动窗口 (生产逻辑)
grass_date BETWEEN (DATE('${grass_date}') - INTERVAL 89 DAYS) AND DATE('${grass_date}')
```

### 地域与时区
```sql
-- 标准查询模式
grass_region = upper('${region}')
AND tz_type = 'local'           -- 约 70% 查询使用

-- regional 时区 (Brand Ads 分析常用)
AND tz_type = 'regional'
```

### 生产过滤条件
```sql
-- 上游读取时排除 pricing_type=29
AND pricing_type != 29
```

### Placement 过滤 (Brand Ads / 效果分析)
```sql
-- Shop Simple ADS
AND placement = 20

-- Manual Shop ADS
AND placement = 3

-- Manual Search ADS
AND placement IN (0, 4, 1000, 1200)

-- Shop Simple + Manual Shop 组合
AND placement IN (3, 20)

-- 过滤零表现记录
AND impression_cnt_7d > 0
AND expenditure_amt_usd_7d > 0
```

## Common JOIN Patterns

### Shop 级聚合 JOIN (最常用)
```sql
-- 按 shop_id + grass_region + tz_type 三键关联
FROM dim_advertiser dim
LEFT JOIN ads_perf
ON dim.shop_id = ads_perf.shop_id
   AND dim.grass_region = ads_perf.grass_region
   AND dim.tz_type = ads_perf.tz_type
```

### Ads 级关联 JOIN (Brand Ads)
```sql
-- 按 ads_id + grass_date 关联广告主日报
FROM mp_paidads.dws_advertise_performance_nd__reg_s0_live u
INNER JOIN mp_paidads.ads_advertise_mkt_1d__reg_s0_live v
ON u.ads_id = v.ads_id
   AND u.grass_date = v.grass_date
```

### 双表对比 JOIN (数据校验)
```sql
-- 全维度 FULL JOIN 对比 prod vs dev
FROM prod_table a
FULL JOIN dev_table b
ON a.shop_id = b.shop_id
   AND a.grass_region = b.grass_region
   AND a.ads_id = b.ads_id
   AND coalesce(a.seller_id, 0) = coalesce(b.seller_id, 0)
   AND coalesce(a.ads_type, 0) = coalesce(b.ads_type, 0)
   AND a.tz_type = b.tz_type
   AND a.placement = b.placement
WHERE abs(a.ads_gmv_amt_usd_1d - b.ads_gmv_amt_usd_1d) > 0.001
```

## Common Aggregations

### Shop 级全量聚合 (ads_advertiser_mkt_1d 最常用)
```sql
SELECT shop_id, tz_type, grass_region
  ,SUM(impression_cnt_1d) AS impression_cnt_1d
  ,SUM(impression_cnt_7d) AS impression_cnt_7d
  ,SUM(click_cnt_1d) AS click_cnt_1d
  ,SUM(order_cnt_1d) AS order_cnt_1d
  ,SUM(ads_gmv_amt_local_1d) AS ads_gmv_amt_local_1d
  ,SUM(ads_gmv_amt_usd_1d) AS ads_gmv_amt_usd_1d
  ,SUM(expenditure_amt_local_1d) AS expenditure_amt_local_1d
  ,SUM(expenditure_amt_usd_1d) AS expenditure_amt_usd_1d
  -- ... all window sizes (1d/7d/30d/60d/90d)
FROM mp_paidads.dws_advertise_performance_nd__reg_s0_live
WHERE grass_region = upper('${region}')
  AND grass_date = DATE('${grass_date}')
GROUP BY shop_id, tz_type, grass_region
```

### L7D 消耗聚合
```sql
SELECT grass_region, shop_id
  ,SUM(expenditure_amt_usd_1d) AS expenditure_amt_usd_l7d
  ,SUM(expenditure_amt_usd_1d) / 7 AS avg_expenditure_amt_usd_l7d
FROM mp_paidads.dws_advertise_performance_nd__reg_s0_live
WHERE grass_region = upper('${region}')
  AND grass_date >= date_sub('${grass_date}', 6)
  AND grass_date <= date'${grass_date}'
GROUP BY grass_region, shop_id
```

### 卖家生命周期标签 (30/60天消耗)
```sql
SELECT shop_id
  ,SUM(expenditure_amt_usd_30d) AS expenditure_amt_usd_30d
  ,SUM(expenditure_amt_usd_60d) AS expenditure_amt_usd_60d
FROM mp_paidads.dws_advertise_performance_nd__reg_s0_live
WHERE grass_region = upper('${region}')
  AND grass_date = DATE('${grass_date}')
  AND tz_type = 'local'
GROUP BY shop_id
```

### Placement 维度聚合 (Brand Ads 分析)
```sql
SELECT grass_region, placement, shop_id
  ,SUM(broad_gmv_amt_local_30d) AS broad_gmv_30d
  ,SUM(expenditure_amt_local_30d) AS expenditure_30d
  ,SUM(broad_gmv_amt_local_30d) / SUM(expenditure_amt_local_30d) AS roi_30d
FROM mp_paidads.dws_advertise_performance_nd__reg_s0_live
WHERE tz_type = 'regional'
  AND grass_date = DATE('${grass_date}')
  AND placement IN (3, 20)
  AND expenditure_amt_local_7d > 0
GROUP BY grass_region, placement, shop_id
```

### Snippet 4: 数据校验 (prod vs dev)
```sql
-- 对比两表 ads_id 级别 1d 指标差异
SELECT a.ads_id, a.shop_id, a.grass_region
  ,abs(a.ads_gmv_amt_usd_1d - b.ads_gmv_amt_usd_1d) AS gmv_usd_diff
  ,a.impression_cnt_1d != b.impression_cnt_1d AS imp_diff
FROM mp_paidads.dws_advertise_performance_nd__reg_s0_live a
JOIN dev_mp_paidads.dws_advertise_performance_nd__reg_s0_live b
  ON a.shop_id = b.shop_id
  AND a.grass_region = b.grass_region
  AND a.ads_id = b.ads_id
  AND a.tz_type = b.tz_type
  AND a.placement = b.placement
WHERE a.grass_date = '2022-09-13'
  AND b.grass_date = '2022-09-13'
  AND (abs(a.ads_gmv_amt_usd_1d - b.ads_gmv_amt_usd_1d) > 0.001
    OR a.impression_cnt_1d != b.impression_cnt_1d)
```

### Snippet 5: Placement 维度 ROI 分析 (Brand Ads)
```sql
-- 按 placement 拆分手动 Shop ADS / Search ADS / Shop Simple 的效果对比
,shop_ads AS (
    SELECT grass_region, grass_date, shop_id
      ,SUM(ads_gmv_amt_usd_7d) / SUM(expenditure_amt_usd_7d) AS roi_7d_shopads
    FROM mp_paidads.dws_advertise_performance_nd__reg_s0_live
    WHERE tz_type = 'regional'
      AND grass_date > date_add('day', -30, current_date)
      AND placement = 3
      AND expenditure_amt_usd_7d > 0
    GROUP BY grass_region, grass_date, shop_id
)
,search_ads AS (
    SELECT grass_region, grass_date, shop_id
      ,SUM(ads_gmv_amt_usd_7d) / SUM(expenditure_amt_usd_7d) AS roi_7d_searchads
    FROM mp_paidads.dws_advertise_performance_nd__reg_s0_live
    WHERE tz_type = 'regional'
      AND grass_date > date_add('day', -30, current_date)
      AND placement IN (0, 4, 1000, 1200)
      AND expenditure_amt_usd_7d > 0
    GROUP BY grass_region, grass_date, shop_id
)
,shop_simple AS (
    SELECT grass_region, grass_date, shop_id
      ,SUM(ads_gmv_amt_usd_7d) / SUM(expenditure_amt_usd_7d) AS roi_7d_simpleshop
    FROM mp_paidads.dws_advertise_performance_nd__reg_s0_live
    WHERE tz_type = 'regional'
      AND grass_date > date_add('day', -30, current_date)
      AND placement = 20
      AND expenditure_amt_usd_7d > 0
    GROUP BY grass_region, grass_date, shop_id
)
```

### 分区写入策略
```sql
INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE dws_advertise_performance_nd__reg_s0_live
  PARTITION (tz_type, grass_region, grass_date)

-- 写入后添加分区
ALTER TABLE dws_advertise_performance_nd__${region}_s0_live
  ADD IF NOT EXISTS PARTITION (grass_date = "${grass_date}")
```

### 生产逻辑摘要
从 `dws_advertise_performance_1d` 取 90 天历史数据，用 CASE WHEN 时间窗口标记 (is_today / is_7d / is_30d / is_60d / is_90d)，按 ads_id + placement + ads_type + shop_id + seller_id + tz_type + grass_region 聚合。ads_type 逻辑：`if(placement=20, 'shop_simple', ads_type)`。过滤条件：`pricing_type != 29`。

窗口定义：
- 1d: `grass_date = DATE('${grass_date}')`
- 7d: `grass_date BETWEEN (DATE - INTERVAL 6 DAYS) AND DATE`
- 30d: `grass_date BETWEEN (DATE - INTERVAL 29 DAYS) AND DATE`
- 60d: `grass_date BETWEEN (DATE - INTERVAL 59 DAYS) AND DATE`
- 90d: `grass_date BETWEEN (DATE - INTERVAL 89 DAYS) AND DATE`

### DDL 摘要
```sql
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS dws_advertise_performance_nd__reg_s0_live (
    ads_id BIGINT, placement BIGINT, ads_type STRING,
    shop_id BIGINT, seller_id BIGINT,
    -- 基础效果指标 (1d/7d/30d/60d/90d)
    impression_cnt_{1d,7d,30d,60d,90d} BIGINT,
    click_cnt_{1d,7d,30d,60d,90d} BIGINT,
    order_cnt_{1d,7d,30d,60d,90d} BIGINT,
    paid_order_cnt_ytd_1d BIGINT, confirmed_order_cnt_ytd_1d BIGINT,
    ads_items_sold_cnt_{1d,7d,30d,60d,90d} BIGINT,
    -- 收入 (local + usd)
    ads_gmv_amt_local_{1d,7d,30d,60d,90d} DOUBLE,
    ads_gmv_amt_usd_{1d,7d,30d,60d,90d} DOUBLE,
    -- 消耗 (local + usd)
    expenditure_amt_local_{1d,7d,30d,60d,90d} DOUBLE,
    expenditure_amt_usd_{1d,7d,30d,60d,90d} DOUBLE,
    -- 衍生比率 (COALESCE 计算，不可直接 SUM)
    ctr_{1d,7d,30d,60d,90d} DOUBLE,
    cir_{1d,7d,30d,60d,90d} DOUBLE,
    cr_{1d,7d,30d,60d,90d} DOUBLE,
    cpc_local_{1d,7d,30d,60d,90d} DOUBLE,
    cpc_usd_{1d,7d,30d,60d,90d} DOUBLE,
    roi_{1d,7d,30d,60d,90d} DOUBLE,
    -- Broad 指标
    broad_gmv_amt_local_{1d,7d,30d,60d,90d} DOUBLE,
    broad_gmv_amt_usd_{1d,7d,30d,60d,90d} DOUBLE,
    broad_roi_{1d,7d,30d,60d,90d} DOUBLE,
    broad_order_cnt_{1d,7d,30d,60d,90d} BIGINT,
    -- Deduct 指标
    ads_deduct_impression_cnt_{1d,7d,30d,60d,90d} BIGINT,
    -- 分区列
    tz_type STRING, grass_region STRING, grass_date DATE
) USING PARQUET
PARTITIONED BY (tz_type, grass_region, grass_date)
LOCATION 'hdfs://D2/projects/data_paidadsmart/hive/mp_paidads/dws_advertise_performance_nd';
```

## Derived Metrics (派生指标)

以下指标在写表中通过 COALESCE 公式计算，读取时**不可直接 SUM**：

| Metric | Formula | Window |
|--------|---------|--------|
| ctr (点击率) | `COALESCE(click_cnt / impression_cnt, 0.0)` | 1d,7d,30d,60d,90d |
| cir (费收率) | `COALESCE(expenditure / ads_gmv, 0.0)` | 1d,7d,30d,60d,90d |
| cr (转化率) | `COALESCE(order_cnt / click_cnt, 0.0)` | 1d,7d,30d,60d,90d |
| cpc (单次点击成本) | `COALESCE(expenditure / click_cnt, 0.0)` | local/usd, 1d-90d |
| roi (投资回报率) | `COALESCE(ads_gmv / expenditure, 0.0)` | 1d,7d,30d,60d,90d |
| broad_roi | `COALESCE(broad_gmv / expenditure, 0.0)` | 1d,7d,30d,60d,90d |

**读取时如何聚合比率指标**：不要直接 SUM，应从基础指标重新计算，例如：
```sql
-- 正确: SUM 分子分母后做除法
SUM(ads_gmv_amt_local_7d) / SUM(expenditure_amt_local_7d) AS roi_7d

-- 错误: 直接 SUM 预计算比率
SUM(roi_7d)  -- 无意义
```
